classification: Confirmed CI structural false-green policy: pytest returned success with three disclosed skips; no deployed broker incident proven
signal: Prior Cloud PAPER Safety CI concluded SUCCESS even when repository pytest reported 3 skipped integration tests; this is not full mandatory non-skipped verification
root_cause: Workflow executed pytest -q -rs but did not enforce zero skipped cases or require machine-readable JUnit proof
upstream: Credentials/external Colab/Windows-only integration prerequisites missing from Ubuntu environment
downstream: Green structural CI status could be misread as full production certification despite untested gates

before.pytest: 8 failed, 601 passed, 3 skipped, 3 warnings, 282 subtests passed
before.reproduction: Eight test-first negative assertions fail because guard is absent and workflow does not generate JUnit

repair.description: Generate JUnit XML, fail closed on any skipped/failure/error/zero-test/missing/malformed/inconsistent JUnit; do not weaken existing PAPER flags

expected_after: Repository pytest can pass its runnable tests, but workflow must conclude FAILURE with CI_TEST_GATE_BLOCKED skipped=3 until integration prerequisites are resolved
prevention_hypothesis: Any skipped pytest case prevents Cloud PAPER Safety CI from showing success; a complete non-skipped JUnit report alone can pass the test-count gate but never substitutes for deployed runtime proof
rollback: Revert isolated gate/test/workflow commits on owned branch after governed review; never turn mandatory skips into pass
recurrence_reopen: Any workflow SUCCESS while pytest JUnit has skipped/failure/error/zero/missing or inconsistent counts, or untested head, reopens this incident
scope: Operations 1-1919 remain registered and additive; no complete lane closure or production certification
